heading: USB Cable
bottomHtml: A USB cable (Universal Serial Bus) is a common data and power connector used to link computers, smartphones, cameras, printers, and other devices. It allows for fast data transfer and device charging, with various types like USB-A, USB-B, USB-C, and Micro-USB to fit different ports and functions
